invariants.rationale: The operationType parameter is used directly for a comparison, so it must not be null.
instantTime is passed to methods and used to create HoodieInstant; must not be null to avoid NullPointerException.
table is dereferenced multiple times for method calls, so must not be null on entry.
pendingCompactionTimeline is used for method calls and thus must not be null on entry.
A static enum constant, likely always non-null; asserted to avoid potential null dereference in equals.
